correctness.rationale: Every diagram admits the explicitly checked same-rank factorization alpha=t e, where e is a full-domain rank-r idempotent. Every singular rank-r transformation decomposes via an idempotent kernel retraction followed by empty-spot moves of labeled tokens, each move represented by a rank-r idempotent. Three-layer product and idempotence verified exhaustively for all 20681 singular diagrams n=2..5; lower-ideal closures verified n=2..4.

originality.rationale: Inspected original 2020 East–Gray open problem and the full 2025 Carroll–East–Fresacher paper: later work proves top singular ideal generation, not the asserted factorization by idempotents at the element’s exact rank or smaller proper rank ideals. Other known partition ideal results concern a larger monoid. Indexed mathematical-record searches for the theorem and aliases did not reveal a decisive overlap. Priority remains subject to independent search.
